text:
maria: Quick sync — I ran a focused bakeoff (AWQ / GPTQ / INT8 / FP8) on llama-2-13b-chat against our prod dialog workload. Uploads + artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/bakeoffs/175945. Need input on canary rollout + fallback rules across hosted/dedicated/private.

ajay: Can you paste the core numbers (MMLU / TruthfulQA / latency / 95p)?

maria: Here are the core numbers from the eval harness (prod-1000 + MMLU/TruthfulQA):
```
Model Variant | MMLU acc | TruthfulQA acc | avg token latency (ms) | 95p latency (ms)
FP16 baseline | 73.4%    | 52.1%          | 24.3                  | 48.6
AWQ int4     | 72.9%    | 51.8%          | 18.5                  | 40.2
GPTQ int4    | 72.2%    | 51.1%          | 17.1                  | 38.7
INT8 (per-layer) | 71.0%| 50.5%          | 16.8                  | 39.0
FP8 (experimental) | 73.1%| 51.9%        | 15.9                  | 37.5
Delta vs FP16: AWQ -0.5% MMLU, GPTQ -1.2%, INT8 -2.4%, FP8 -0.3%
```
maria: Notes: AWQ gives a solid latency win with a tiny MMLU drop (-0.5%). GPTQ has slightly worse quality in our prompts. FP8 looks promising (best latency + small accuracy delta) but hit OOMs on some long-context (>8k) runs in staging. prod-1000 EM deltas: AWQ -0.6%, GPTQ -1.8%, INT8 -3.0%, FP8 -0.2%.

ajay: Good context. For hosted canary I'd propose: AWQ as primary candidate, GPTQ a small parallel test, FP8 hold in staging only until OOMs are resolved. Suggest concrete rollback thresholds: absolute prod-1000 EM drop >1.0%, or MMLU drop >2.0%, or 95p latency increase >15% -> auto-rollback to previous variant.

zach: +1. Also add a small adversarial canary set (200 prompts) to catch prompt-sensitive hallucinations. Trigger rollback if TruthfulQA or adversarial-set error rate increases by >1.5% sustained for 5m. Route by customer tier: free/dev traffic can go to AWQ earlier; paid/dedicated remain pinned to FP16 unless they opt in.

lisa: Dedicated rollout idea: reserve a 10% dedicated pool for AWQ for 2 weeks and require zero regressions on our customer-critical evals before widening. Private deployments: opt-in only (AMI/config flag) — no automatic routing. Add OOM fallback: if a model instance OOMs, immediate fallback to FP16 on that node + create incident.

perf-bot: CI: inference-bakeoff-175945 finished. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/inference/bakeoff/175945 (perf traces, quant logs, KV cache heatmaps).

ajay: Operational plan (proposal): schedule canary during low traffic window (Tue 2026-03-24 03:00 UTC):
1) Deploy AWQ canary at 1% hosted traffic.
2) After 30m no alarms -> increase to 5%.
3) After 2 hours no regressions -> 20% and enable AWQ on dedicated reserve.
Auto-rollback triggers: product EM delta >1.0% (5m moving avg), MMLU drop >2% (agg), 95p latency +15%. PagerDuty -> eng-oncall on rollback.

maria: I'll run another long-context FP8 stress test and post results by EOD. Assigning tasks: @zach to draft canary yaml + routing policy, @ajay to write alert queries and rollback automation, @lisa to update dedicated runbook, @perf-bot to push final artifacts into CI link above. I'll follow-up in #eng-sre for alert creation once config is posted.

zach: On it — I'll post the canary yaml and a sample rollout policy before EOD.

lisa: Also please add a "units saved per 1M tokens" metric for finance so we can show estimated cost delta per variant.

maria: Thanks — after we validate AWQ in hosted & dedicated we'll re-run full FP8 stress and decide if FP8 can enter staged-hosted (no auto-route). Will keep thread updated.
